days.brief: Eucla and Gascoyne Junction lead the way today: mostly sunny, around 30° with a gentle breeze. The set-up: a cold front brings cooler, showery weather to the south; high pressure is building over the south-west, which means settled, dry air and mostly light winds; an inland trough sits further east, where it is hotter and more unsettled. That is exactly what makes the south the place to be. Mount Augustus, Exmouth and Carnarvon are not far behind. Least appealing: Kiwirrkurra, with 40° heat and strong winds.

Meekatharra and Mount Magnet lead the way tomorrow: mostly sunny, around 29° with light winds. The set-up: a cold front brings cooler, showery weather to the south at some stage; high pressure is building over the south-west, which means settled, dry air and mostly light winds; an inland trough sits further east, where it is hotter and more unsettled. Murchison, Leonora and Laverton are not far behind. Least appealing: Kiwirrkurra, with 42° heat and strong winds.

Moora and Badgingarra lead the way on Monday: partly cloudy, around 26° with light winds. The set-up: a cold front brings cooler, showery weather to the south at some stage; high pressure is building over the south-west, which means settled, dry air and mostly light winds; an inland trough sits further east, where it is hotter and more unsettled. That is exactly what makes the south the place to be. Eneabba, Midland and Gingin are not far behind. Least appealing: Kiwirrkurra, with 41° heat.

Mukinbudin and Beacon lead the way on Tuesday: sunny, around 28° with a gentle breeze. Morawa, Hyden and Brookton are not far behind. Least appealing: Kiwirrkurra, with 41° heat and sunny morning. possible storm.

Collie and Gnowangerup lead the way on Wednesday: mostly sunny, around 25° with light winds. Narrogin, Wagin and Dowerin are not far behind. Least appealing: Kiwirrkurra, with 40° heat and showers. storm developing.

Pinjarra and Collie lead the way on Thursday: sunny, around 25° with a gentle breeze. Katanning, Badgingarra and Ellenbrook are not far behind. Least appealing: Telfer, with 43° heat and strong winds.

Morawa and Corrigin lead the way on Friday: mostly sunny, around 29° with a gentle breeze. Dalwallinu, Northam and Merredin are not far behind. Least appealing: Kiwirrkurra, with 40° heat and shower or two.
